summary.en: An eigenvector of a matrix is a direction the transformation only stretches, never rotates, and the stretch factor is its eigenvalue — finding them reveals the axes along which a complicated transformation acts as simply as multiplication.
summary.et: Maatriksi omavektor on suund, mida teisendus ainult venitab, kunagi ei pööra, ja venitusteguriks on selle omaväärtus — nende leidmine paljastab teljed, mille suunas keeruline teisendus toimib sama lihtsalt kui korrutamine.
